description: Turns labeled with the recipe chosen among one category's members, for the turn site's recipe moment (TURN_RECIPE_SITE). Split: a case with no split field or split fit is in the fit split; split holdout was written before any score on it was seen and is scored once against cuts chosen on fit. New cases alternate fit and holdout within each authored class.

architect.description: Designs a change across boundaries and slices it into a sprint. Covers contracts, migrations, and validation gates, and turns an existing plan into a dependency-ordered sprint through its bound sprint-plan skill.

coder.description: Implements bounded code changes, repairs, and refactors. Behavior-preserving by default.

debugger.description: Diagnoses failing code, tests, or runs without editing. Reads receipts, logs, and runtime behavior to name the cause.

documenter.description: Writes docs and examples from source. No shell; verification uses declared checks.

git-master.description: Runs bounded git operations end to end. Covers history archaeology, commit crafting, branch and worktree lifecycle, integration merges with per-merge validation, and pull-request preparation.

oracle.description: Shadow advisor that protects consistency with prior decisions and returns the strongest challenge to a question.

provenance.description: Reads receipts, diffs, and telemetry for evidence. Shadow agent for source-backed handoffs.

researcher.description: Researches external docs, standards, and papers. Shadow agent for coding decisions, official documentation, release notes, and academic sources.

scout.description: Broad repository reconnaissance with cited findings. Use for codebase orientation, structure and entry-point mapping, or multi-file symbol hunting; spends no main-context tool calls.

tester.description: Adds focused deterministic regression and coverage tests.

verifier.description: Runs test, lint, build, review, and release gates. Reports each gate independently.

wiki-writer.description: Plans a repository wiki or writes one wiki page. Works against a supplied plan.

world-knowledge.description: Current open-world discovery, ecosystem comparisons, broad external context, and advisory second opinions. Reports honestly when discovery is unavailable.

materio-workflow-planner.description: Build a resource-aware dependency plan with researcher assumptions and tagged defaults.

wtfp-argument-verifier.description: Verify that completed section text actually delivers the claims, evidence, constraints, and connections promised by its plan. Execution summaries are navigation aids, not proof; verdicts must be grounded in the manuscript itself.

claude-code.description: Claude Code, a peer coding agent reached over the Agent Client Protocol, for handing a whole coding task to it.
